originalText: Source-setting context for 1902.07724: main assignment M F3 on A and K H3 on B; many formulas use Mpl=1; fixed-flux scalings and the distinction between geometric KS deformation and axio-dilaton are retained. Extracted context flags other,未
replacementText:
For 1902.07724, the main flux assignment across PDF pp. 7–8 is quantized F3 flux M on the vanishing A-cycle and H3 flux K on its symplectic dual B-cycle. The no-scale potential in Eq. (2.5) uses Mpl = 1; the second line of Eq. (2.7) explicitly restores the Planck scale. The stabilization expression in Eq. (2.8) assumes, for simplicity, that the axio-dilaton is fixed at S = gs^−1. Keep the dilute-flux validity restriction for the preceding supergravity action on p. 8 separate from the strong-backreaction warped regime introduced on p. 10.

Distinguish the axio-dilaton S = e^−ϕ + iC0 defined on p. 7 from the geometric S entering the KS metric in Eq. (2.18) on p. 10, which the text relates to the conifold modulus Z. Preserve the source-local flux wording: p. 10 places H3 on A and F3 on its symplectic dual B, reversing the field-to-cycle assignment stated across pp. 7–8. In the illustrative orientifold construction of footnote 11 on p. 31, the involution exchanges A and A′, the F3 integral on A is labeled K and that on A′ is −K, and the D3-brane wraps A + A′. This example accompanies the explicit assumption that both Z and the vector field survive the projection. Report these local differences without silently identifying their flux labels or declaring a paper error.

These are bounded convention notes for the supplied passages. Those passages do not establish a general prescription that moduli scalings hold all flux integers and spectator parameters fixed.
